description.value:
Effect Hit bonus +2. Applying a debuff grants tracked Enthrall, capped at 3 stacks for 3 target turns. At 2 or more stacks, all allied-source DoTs on that target gain one die step while the mark lasts; cap d12. An allied direct hit grants that ally speed +5 feet for 3 turns, once per turn. Ends if you fall unconscious.

Equipment: Occupy the Light Cone slot; matching nihility Path required.

source.custom: Honkai: Star Rail / Telys D&D conversion
